description: This file contains unit tests for WebSocket server and client implementations within the WPEFramework project, utilizing Google Test framework. It defines test classes for WebSocket communication over sockets, manages synchronization primitives, and runs a test case to verify message exchange between client and server.

classes.name: TextSocketServer
classes.description: A WebSocket server class derived from Core::StreamTextType, managing server-side WebSocket communication and synchronization.

classes.name: TextSocketClient
classes.description: A WebSocket client class derived from Core::StreamTextType, managing client-side WebSocket communication and message handling.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles state changes in the WebSocket server, signals when the server is open.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Handles incoming messages for both server and client classes.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Placeholder for sending messages over WebSocket, currently empty.

methods.name: GetState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the server (whether it is open).

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Client method to wait for message reception.

methods.name: Retrieve
methods.description: Client method to retrieve the last received message.
